note: Hand-authored consumer selection guidance. One entry per family in architecture/manifest.json; verify selection keeps them in step. Alternatives name family ids, never symbols.

admin/patterns/access.chooseWhen: Admin screens present credentials, role permissions and destructive confirmations.
admin/patterns/access.avoidWhen: You are changing who a resource is shared with.

admin/patterns/commerce.chooseWhen: Admin screens present orders, invoices, carts, fulfilment and loyalty.
admin/patterns/commerce.avoidWhen: The record is a catalogue product, whose options and readiness live in features/products.

base/accordion.chooseWhen: Several titled sections share one column and the reader opens them one at a time.
base/accordion.avoidWhen: Only one section can collapse, or the panel is a disclosure attached to a control.

base/action-menu.chooseWhen: A row, card or header offers the same set of actions repeatedly and the overflow must collapse consistently.
base/action-menu.avoidWhen: You are building a bespoke menu anatomy, or the trigger is a right-click.

base/alert-dialog.chooseWhen: Documenting or extending the alert-dialog anatomy itself inside base.
base/alert-dialog.avoidWhen: You are confirming a destructive action in an app — that lifecycle, focus trap and async state belong to ConfirmDialog.

base/aspect-ratio.chooseWhen: A media box must hold a fixed ratio while its width is decided by the layout.
base/aspect-ratio.avoidWhen: The element already has intrinsic dimensions, or you want a square avatar.

base/avatar.chooseWhen: Showing a person or entity as an image with an initials fallback, alone or stacked.
base/avatar.avoidWhen: The image is content rather than identity, or you need an upload affordance.

base/badge.chooseWhen: A short status or count sits beside the thing it describes and carries a semantic tone.
base/badge.avoidWhen: The text is a full sentence, or the tone is decoration rather than state.

base/batch-action-bar.chooseWhen: A multi-select produces a selection whose actions must appear without shifting the list.
base/batch-action-bar.avoidWhen: Actions apply to one row, or the surface is a page-level form.

base/buttons.chooseWhen: Any activation control — including one that carries a loading state, a tooltip, or sits in a group.
base/buttons.avoidWhen: The control navigates and should be an anchor, or it toggles a persistent state.

base/cards.chooseWhen: A surface needs visible chrome — border, padding, header and footer regions.
base/cards.avoidWhen: You are framing reusable content that the call site should frame instead, or the rows are a list.

base/carousel.chooseWhen: Peer items exceed the width and horizontal paging is the intended reading order.
base/carousel.avoidWhen: All items should be visible at once, or the overflow is a tab strip.

base/chart.chooseWhen: Rendering a Recharts chart that must inherit the kit's tokens, legend and tooltip chrome.
base/chart.avoidWhen: The number is a single figure with a trend, or the chart needs a titled card frame.

base/choice-inputs.chooseWhen: The user picks from a known, closed set — checkbox, radio, switch or select.
base/choice-inputs.avoidWhen: The set is large enough to need filtering, or the values are free text.

base/combobox.chooseWhen: Composing a filtered single- or multi-select from its parts, with options already in memory.
base/combobox.avoidWhen: Options arrive from a fetch, or you want the assembled control rather than the anatomy.

base/command.chooseWhen: A keyboard-first palette lists commands across groups, usually behind a shortcut.
base/command.avoidWhen: The palette searches application records rather than commands.

base/context-menu.chooseWhen: The trigger is a right-click on a region that has its own actions.
base/context-menu.avoidWhen: The trigger is a visible button, or the actions repeat across rows.

base/copyable.chooseWhen: A value exists to be copied — an id, key, or reference — and needs copy feedback.
base/copyable.avoidWhen: The value is prose, or the copy affordance belongs to a whole block.

base/date-pickers.chooseWhen: The user picks a date, range, month or time from a calendar surface.
base/date-pickers.avoidWhen: The date is typed as text, or you are only displaying a date.

base/dialog.chooseWhen: Documenting or extending the dialog anatomy itself inside base.
base/dialog.avoidWhen: You are presenting a modal in an app — the portal, focus trap, scroll lock and async confirm lifecycle belong to features/overlays.

base/direction.chooseWhen: A subtree renders right-to-left and its primitives must follow.
base/direction.avoidWhen: The whole document is RTL and the html element already declares it.

base/display.chooseWhen: Presenting label/key and value facts, a collapsible region, a keyboard hint or a scrollable pane.
base/display.avoidWhen: The pair is an editable field, or the row carries identity and actions.

base/dropdown-menu.chooseWhen: Composing a menu anatomy — submenus, radio and checkbox items — from its parts.
base/dropdown-menu.avoidWhen: You want the assembled row-actions control, or the trigger is a right-click.

base/feedback.chooseWhen: A region reports its own state — informational alert, empty, loading, error, or progress.
base/feedback.avoidWhen: The placeholder should mimic the eventual layout, or the message is transient.

base/forms.chooseWhen: Assembling a form's visible structure — label, control, support text, sections and an actions bar.
base/forms.avoidWhen: The fields come from a schema, or you only need the binding hooks.

base/forms-numeric.chooseWhen: A numeric field carries a unit, currency or precision the input itself must enforce.
base/forms-numeric.avoidWhen: The number is plain, or it is being displayed rather than edited.

base/hover-card.chooseWhen: Hovering a reference reveals a preview the reader does not have to act on.
base/hover-card.avoidWhen: The content is essential, interactive, or must be reachable by keyboard alone.

base/input-group.chooseWhen: A control needs an affix inside its border — an icon, unit, prefix button or counter.
base/input-group.avoidWhen: The affix is a separate field, or the label belongs above the control.

base/item.chooseWhen: A row carries identity — media, title, description and trailing actions — in a list or a menu.
base/item.avoidWhen: The row is tabular data with aligned columns, or the surface needs card chrome.

base/label.chooseWhen: Naming a form control so the label and control are associated.
base/label.avoidWhen: The text is a heading, a static field name, or a value's caption.

base/menubar.chooseWhen: An application-style menu bar sits persistently across the top of a workspace.
base/menubar.avoidWhen: The menu hangs off a single button, or the bar is site navigation.

base/navigation.chooseWhen: Moving between sibling views or pages — tabs, breadcrumbs, pagination, page heading.
base/navigation.avoidWhen: The destinations are application shell regions, or the tabs are saved data views.

base/navigation-menu.chooseWhen: Site navigation needs grouped panels of links under top-level triggers.
base/navigation-menu.avoidWhen: The items are commands rather than destinations, or the shell owns the navigation.

base/otp-input.chooseWhen: A one-time code is entered as separate character cells.
base/otp-input.avoidWhen: The code is pasted as one string into an ordinary field.

base/overlay.chooseWhen: Building a new modal surface inside the kit that must share the dialog/sheet anatomy.
base/overlay.avoidWhen: You are consuming the kit — application modals come from features/overlays.

base/popover.chooseWhen: A non-modal panel is anchored to a trigger and may hold interactive content.
base/popover.avoidWhen: The panel is a list of actions, or it must trap focus and block the page.

base/popover-menu.chooseWhen: A popover's content is a simple list of actions and does not need the full menu anatomy.
base/popover-menu.avoidWhen: Items need submenus, checkboxes or radios, or the actions repeat across rows.

base/qr-code.chooseWhen: A value must be scannable on screen or in print.
base/qr-code.avoidWhen: The value only needs copying to the clipboard rather than scanning off the screen.

base/repeaters.chooseWhen: A field holds a variable-length list the user adds to, reorders or removes from.
base/repeaters.avoidWhen: The list length is fixed, or the shape comes from a schema.

base/resizable.chooseWhen: The user sets the split between panes and the size should persist.
base/resizable.avoidWhen: The split is fixed by the layout, or the region is a page shell.

base/sheet.chooseWhen: Documenting the sheet anatomy, or inside base where features/overlays cannot be imported.
base/sheet.avoidWhen: You are presenting an edge-anchored modal in an app.

base/sidebar.chooseWhen: Composing a collapsible sidebar from its parts, including the mobile presentation.
base/sidebar.avoidWhen: You want the assembled application sidebar with logo, user and workspace slots.

base/skeleton.chooseWhen: A placeholder should hold the eventual layout's shape while data loads.
base/skeleton.avoidWhen: The wait is indeterminate and unstructured, or the region failed.

base/slot.chooseWhen: Merging props onto a caller-supplied element inside a component's own implementation.
base/slot.avoidWhen: You are consuming the kit — public components take a render prop instead.

base/spinner.chooseWhen: A wait is short and has no layout to preview.
base/spinner.avoidWhen: The eventual shape is known, or the wait blocks a whole region.

base/structure.chooseWhen: Passive siblings need consistent spacing, a grid, or a stack — with no semantics of their own.
base/structure.avoidWhen: The children form a titled page region, or the arrangement carries meaning.

base/table.chooseWhen: Writing table markup directly, with rows you control and no sorting or selection.
base/table.avoidWhen: The table needs columns, sorting, selection or a toolbar.

base/text-inputs.chooseWhen: Free text is typed — plain, multiline, password, search or slug.
base/text-inputs.avoidWhen: The value is numeric with a unit, or picked from a set.

base/timeline.chooseWhen: Composing a generic vertical sequence of dated entries.
base/timeline.avoidWhen: The sequence is a changelog, milestones or a step tracker.

base/toaster.chooseWhen: A message is transient, non-blocking, and reports the outcome of an action.
base/toaster.avoidWhen: The message belongs to a region, or the user must act on it.

base/toolbar.chooseWhen: A persistent group of related actions or controls needs one tab stop and arrow-key navigation.
base/toolbar.avoidWhen: The actions open from a trigger, select one value, or navigate between pages.

base/toggle.chooseWhen: A control holds a pressed state, alone or as one of a mutually exclusive group.
base/toggle.avoidWhen: The state is a form value that submits, or the control performs an action.

base/tooltip.chooseWhen: A short, non-essential hint labels a control on hover or focus.
base/tooltip.avoidWhen: The content is interactive, long, or required to understand the control.

base/typography.chooseWhen: Rendering library-owned copy in a role — heading, body, label, link or sanitized rich text.
base/typography.avoidWhen: The text is a formatted data value rather than prose.

base/upload.chooseWhen: The user contributes files — dropzone, avatar, image, or a tray with progress.
base/upload.avoidWhen: Existing assets are being browsed and picked rather than added.

base/value-inputs.chooseWhen: A single typed value needs a specialised editor — colour, datetime, phone, slider or tags.
base/value-inputs.avoidWhen: The value is plain text or a number with a unit.

features/actions.chooseWhen: The same operation runs from a table row, a card menu and the command palette, and all three must get one confirm, one loading state and one error path.
features/actions.avoidWhen: One surface owns the action and nothing else invokes it — a registry then adds indirection for a single caller.

features/activities.chooseWhen: An audit or activity log renders actor, change and time, grouped by day.
features/activities.avoidWhen: The entries are milestones or a changelog, or the thread is a discussion.

features/ai-chat.chooseWhen: A conversational surface streams assistant messages, tool calls, artifacts and attachments.
features/ai-chat.avoidWhen: The thread is human discussion on a record, or the input is a single prompt field.

features/async-preview.chooseWhen: A trigger fetches its content when it opens, and needs loading, empty and error states.
features/async-preview.avoidWhen: The content is already loaded, or the surface is modal.

features/combobox.chooseWhen: Options arrive from a fetch, the field selects application resources, or it proposes completions as the user types.
features/combobox.avoidWhen: The options are a small in-memory list, you are composing a bespoke anatomy, or a trigger character inserts entities into text.

features/comments.chooseWhen: People discuss a record in a thread, with a composer and attachments.
features/comments.avoidWhen: The entries are system-generated, or the conversation is with an assistant.

features/data-view.chooseWhen: One dataset is presented through switchable views with saved tabs, a toolbar and pagination.
features/data-view.avoidWhen: There is one table and no view switching, or you need the table body alone.

features/event-calendar.chooseWhen: Events are placed on a calendar the user navigates by period.
features/event-calendar.avoidWhen: The user is picking a date, or the sequence is chronological rather than spatial.

features/filters.chooseWhen: Users build predicates over fields, with operators, editors and pills.
features/filters.avoidWhen: Filtering is one search box, or the choices are fixed tabs.

features/global-search.chooseWhen: One search surface spans record types, with tabs, idle and empty states.
features/global-search.avoidWhen: The palette lists commands, or the search scopes one collection.

features/kanban.chooseWhen: Records move between columns by dragging, and the board owns that state.
features/kanban.avoidWhen: The columns are read-only, or ordering is a table sort.

features/map.chooseWhen: Geographic data is displayed or drawn, including markers, shapes and draw controls.
features/map.avoidWhen: The location is a single coordinate value to read or type.

features/media-library.chooseWhen: Existing assets are browsed, previewed, searched and picked.
features/media-library.avoidWhen: The user is contributing new files, or one image is being replaced.

features/mentions.chooseWhen: Typing a trigger character suggests entities and inserts them as chips.
features/mentions.avoidWhen: The field selects one resource up front, or the suggestions are commands.

features/overlays.chooseWhen: Any application modal — dialog, sheet or confirmation — including its async confirm lifecycle.
features/overlays.avoidWhen: The panel is non-modal and anchored to its trigger.

features/products.chooseWhen: Presenting catalogue records — options, readiness, policies and quotes — in the admin profile.
features/products.avoidWhen: The record is an order, invoice or shipment.

features/resource.chooseWhen: A record's index or show page needs its standard shell — header, actions bar and sections.
features/resource.avoidWhen: The page is a workspace shell, or the content is one table.

features/resource-assignment.chooseWhen: A resource is shared with or assigned to principals through a dialog.
features/resource-assignment.avoidWhen: You are displaying permissions rather than changing them.

features/rich-text-editor/tiptap.chooseWhen: Configure a custom TipTap engine or schema for RichTextEditor; the default editor already uses TipTap.
features/rich-text-editor/tiptap.avoidWhen: The default StarterKit and mention schema already meets the editing requirements.

features/rich-text-editor.chooseWhen: Users author formatted content with a toolbar and counts.
features/rich-text-editor.avoidWhen: The input is plain multiline text, or the content is only displayed.

features/schema-form.chooseWhen: Fields are generated from a schema at runtime rather than written by hand.
features/schema-form.avoidWhen: The form is known at build time, or you only need field structure.

features/sync.chooseWhen: A synchronisation run is configured over a date range.
features/sync.avoidWhen: The form is a general-purpose date range field.

features/table.chooseWhen: A table needs columns, sorting, selection, cell renderers and a toolbar.
features/table.avoidWhen: The dataset needs several saved views, or you are writing table markup directly.

features/theme-tweaker.chooseWhen: Users change theme, density or scale at runtime and the result must persist.
features/theme-tweaker.avoidWhen: Defaults are set once at the root and never change.

forms.chooseWhen: Binding a field to state you already own, without a form library.
forms.avoidWhen: React Hook Form owns the state, or the fields come from a schema.

forms-rhf.chooseWhen: React Hook Form owns the form state and the kit's fields must bind to it.
forms-rhf.avoidWhen: The state is plain React, or the form is generated from a schema.

theming.chooseWhen: Synthesising a theme from one brand colour, or measuring which foreground is readable on a background.
theming.avoidWhen: Users pick the theme at runtime, or the values are known and can simply be declared in CSS.

index.chooseWhen: Prototyping, where one import is worth more than a small bundle.
index.avoidWhen: Shipping to production — exact subpaths keep the CSS and JS you actually use.

layout/app-shell.chooseWhen: The application needs its outermost frame — a sidebar with an inset, a stacked header over content, or a topbar with a collapsible rail beneath it.
layout/app-shell.avoidWhen: You are inside a shell already and want a region of the page: a titled section, a width constraint, or a two-column split.

layout/auth.chooseWhen: Sign-in, registration and recovery pages share a centred card and optional split panel.
layout/auth.avoidWhen: The page sits inside the authenticated shell.

layout/containers.chooseWhen: A page region needs width constraint, a titled section, or a two-column split.
layout/containers.avoidWhen: The children are peers needing only spacing, or the region is the app shell.

layout/header.chooseWhen: The application header carries breadcrumbs, search, notifications and the user menu.
layout/header.avoidWhen: The heading names a page rather than the application.

layout/navigation.chooseWhen: The shell's own navigation — side, section or category — positions destinations.
layout/navigation.avoidWhen: The user moves between sibling views inside one page.

layout/page.chooseWhen: A page needs its title, description and primary actions in the standard arrangement.
layout/page.avoidWhen: The page is a record's index or show view with a fuller shell.

layout/settings.chooseWhen: Settings pages share an aside navigation beside their content.
layout/settings.avoidWhen: The navigation is the application sidebar, or the sections are tabs.

layout/sidebar.chooseWhen: The assembled application sidebar with logo, workspace switcher and user footer.
layout/sidebar.avoidWhen: You are composing a bespoke sidebar from its parts.

layout/workspace.chooseWhen: The whole authenticated shell — sidebar, header and content — is assembled at once.
layout/workspace.avoidWhen: You are placing one region, or the page is unauthenticated.

patterns/analytics.chooseWhen: Figures are summarised — metric tiles, trends, comparisons, a heatmap or a titled chart card.
patterns/analytics.avoidWhen: You are rendering the chart itself with no framing.

patterns/onboarding.chooseWhen: A checklist tracks setup tasks the user completes over time.
patterns/onboarding.avoidWhen: The steps are one linear flow with a current position.

patterns/timelines.chooseWhen: A sequence is presented as changelog entries, milestones, or a step tracker.
patterns/timelines.avoidWhen: The entries are a system audit log, or the sequence is a calendar.

primitives.chooseWhen: Displaying or formatting exactly one read-only value — currency/money, date, email, file size, initials — with no interaction.
primitives.avoidWhen: The value is editable, or the text is prose in a typographic role.

ui-provider.chooseWhen: Setting display defaults, theme, density and scale for the app or a subtree.
ui-provider.avoidWhen: The value is per-feature policy or domain data, which stays a prop.
